judge.reason: The replay implemented inbound read receipts end-to-end with the actor-is-the-line fix, retained debug logging, and handled the shared-mode review finding with tests, satisfying c1–c11 and n2. However it never ran `bun run build` (or the repo-level test scripts/full ultracite), a check it could have run, so c13 is unmet and the verdict is fail despite tsc and package tests being green.
